text: このしまの　とあるかたの　ため　おしょくじを　つくりに　いくんだ

structure.jp: このしまの　とあるかたの　ため
structure.en: for a certain person on this island

structure.jp: おしょくじを　つくりに　いくんだ
structure.en: I'm going to prepare a meal

patterns.name: 〜ため
patterns.span: とあるかたの　ため
patterns.explanation: のため after a person means 'for that person's sake'. とあるかたの　ため = 'for a certain person'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the short form of a verb, followed by 'go', means 'go in order to do it'. つくりに　いく = 'go to make'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining yourself. いくんだ = 'I'm going, you see'.
